title: Electrothermal Coupling Engine — Iterative Electrical/Thermal Co-Simulation

sourceCodeFiles.description: Typed bidirectional mapping contract between circuit elements and spatial thermal components, including temperature coefficients and convergence options
Fixed-point Picard co-simulation solver with under-relaxation, tri-residual convergence monitoring, energy balance checking, and analytical quadratic benchmark oracle
Cross-domain verification bridge connecting ECAD PCB model, electrical circuit, and spatial thermal multilayer finite-volume solver

Comprehensive 12-case test battery verifying zero coupling, self-stabilizing negative feedback, positive feedback equilibrium, analytical root parity, energy conservation, spatial cross-talk, diodes, and fail-closed safety

acceptanceGates.ET1_RealCoupling: PASS — True bidirectional feedback loop where temperature modulates resistance and Joule heating updates thermal grid
acceptanceGates.ET2_CorrectPhysics: PASS — Positive tempco stabilizes fixed-voltage circuits (P drops) and shifts resistance upwards monotonically
acceptanceGates.ET3_StableIteration: PASS — Damped Picard iteration (theta = 0.7) reliably converges within 2-6 iterations across all tested topologies
acceptanceGates.ET4_EnergyConservation: PASS — Sum of Joule heat equals sum of convective and sink heat within <= 0.1% (exact balance verified)
acceptanceGates.ET5_IndependentReference: PASS — Exact closed-form quadratic root benchmark matches numerical solver within tight tolerance
acceptanceGates.ET6_CanonicalIntegrity: PASS — Directly reuses NodalCircuitSolver and SpatialThermalSolver without secondary or duplicate cores
acceptanceGates.ET7_Evidence: PASS — Complete audit, capability register, gap register, convergence report, and conservation report generated
acceptanceGates.ET8_ZeroRegression: PASS — 100% of previous 001A (Nonlinear Electrical), 001B (Spatial Thermal), and Multidomain test suites pass
